description: Source code for a filesystem abstraction layer using fsspec for checkpoint storage in PyTorch distributed training. Defines classes for reading and writing checkpoint files with support for path management and validation.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: A filesystem abstraction that wraps an fsspec-compatible filesystem, providing methods for stream creation, path manipulation, and file operations.

classes.name: FsspecWriter
classes.description: A checkpoint writer implementation that uses fsspec for file storage, supporting multiple configuration options.

classes.name: FsspecReader
classes.description: A checkpoint reader implementation that uses fsspec for file retrieval.

methods.name: create_stream
methods.description: Context manager to open a file stream with error handling and optional cleanup.

methods.name: concat_path
methods.description: Concatenates a path with a suffix.

methods.name: init_path
methods.description: Initializes the filesystem for a given path.

methods.name: validate_checkpoint_id
methods.description: Validates a checkpoint ID based on URL or Path.
